patch_list: Lets you take screenshots and screen recordings in the app, for example of your student ID.
Turns on the dark theme that is inside the app and makes its background black. Text and backgrounds that the app sets by itself are changed too. Pictures are not changed.
Stops the pop-up with an image, a text and a button that the app shows on the home screen for surveys and notices, including forms you already answered.
Asks the school's login server for an offline session, so the app does not sign you out and send you back to the Microsoft login after about 30 minutes. The server must allow offline sessions.
